title: Pika H3 Flex: turn references into editable AI video

facts.method: Pika official README pinned at 2 Nov commit
facts.limits: Hosted upscaling and audio stems may incur costs; generated edits are not guaranteed to preserve every detail.

scenes.say: Pika can use your reference images and audio to guide an AI video.
scenes.heading: PIKA: IMAGE + AUDIO

scenes.say: H three Flex accepts up to twelve references total: images, video clips and audio. At least one image or video is required.
scenes.heading: 12 REFERENCES · MAX

scenes.say: Add a prompt to guide the shot and use reference video to guide a new generation. Results can vary, and it is not a full editable timeline.
scenes.heading: EDIT THE SHOT

scenes.say: Need separate sound? Pika’s hosted API can return audio stems, including dialogue, music and effects, so you can edit them separately.
scenes.heading: SOUND IN LAYERS

scenes.say: The catch: local generation is four eighty or seven sixty eight p. Four K upscaling and separate audio stems use Pika’s hosted service, and costs can apply.
scenes.heading: LOCAL VS HOSTED

scenes.say: Would you try it for a product video or a music clip? Comment PIKA and I will pin the model.
scenes.heading: YOUR CALL
